'''Incki Kunzler''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who stayed on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Incki Kunzler appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Level 60 Basic Gear vendor on Rishi for the Jedi Consular class. Kunzler and the rest of the class gear vendors at Rishi, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by a single standardized vendor in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
